tv.title: Rate VET
tv.lead: Like an element on a board: what did VET give you and what did it cost you?
tv.commentHint: What helped, what got in the way
tv.thanks: Thank you. This helps the institute improve the tools.
tv.data.1: Your boards stay in this browser unless you share them with a team. Element titles and texts are never sent for statistics.
tv.data.2: When you leave the page after estimating, the institute receives one anonymous summary: how long the visit took, how many elements and estimates there were, the number of participants, whether you exported something and which helpers you used.
tv.data.3: No cookies, no account or device identifiers and no IP address are stored with it. If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, no summary is sent.
tv.data.4: "Rate VET" appears at most once in 14 days. Your two values and the comment are sent only when you press Send.
tv.data.5: The institute uses these numbers only to see whether the tools are worth their cost to people, and to improve them.
